 Mohamed Salah sets new Egypt record
 Mohamed Salah left Liverpool to join Trabzonspor in the summer.
 by Joseph Agbobli 13.11.2026 Add to Preferred Sources Follow DaveOCKOP: Add us as a preferred source on Google.
 Egypt sealed a comfortable 5-0 home win over Malawi in a 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifier on Friday night, giving new coach Ali Maher a winning start to his reign.
 Nasser Maher and Omar Marmoush scored in quick succession inside the opening 10 minutes. Mohamed Hany netted his first international goal with a superb volley before half-time.
 Former Liverpool forward Mohamed Salah completed the rout with a header and a panenka penalty in the 83rd and 94th minutes, respectively.
 The result lifts Egypt to the top of Group B with seven points from three games, three clear of Angola, who face South Sudan on Saturday.
 Salah further cemented his status as one of Egypt’s greatest-ever players, becoming the country’s all-time leading goalscorer during the November international break.
 His brace against Malawi took his international tally to 70 goals in 123 appearances, surpassing former striker Hossam Hassan’s record. The record-breaking goal came in style, with Salah converting a Panenka penalty to complete Egypt’s emphatic victory.
 It is another milestone in a remarkable career for the 34-year-old, who has continued to break records throughout his time in football, particularly during his spell at Liverpool.
 Despite his departure from Anfield in the summer, Salah has maintained his impressive form, continuing to make history for his country.
 Salah was at the heart of Egypt’s campaign in the United States, as the Pharaohs qualified for only their fourth FIFA World Cup. They secured their first-ever victory at the tournament and reached the round of 16, making it an unforgettable summer.
 Although eventual finalists Argentina ended their run, Egypt had plenty of positives to take from the campaign. Shortly afterwards, Salah had to decide on the next chapter of his club career.
 He opted to join Turkish Super Lig side Trabzonspor in the summer following the expiration of his Liverpool contract at the end of the 2025/26 season.
 Salah has racked up 16 appearances, scored 11 goals and provided five assists for Trabzonspor across all competitons this camapaign.
